questions.question: At which ground did Z Magubane record their career-best bowling figures (3-10, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2019/02/23.

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (List A)?
Who took South Africa Women's first-ever ODI five-wicket haul, with remarkable figures of 5 for 7 against Pakistan in February 2008?
questions.explanation: Smith took 5 for 7 in 8 overs against Pakistan at Stellenbosch on 24 February 2008, South Africa's first ODI five-wicket haul.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Titans or Dragons?
At which ground did Boland record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl — largest win by runs of 533, against Kei on 2011/01/29.

questions.question: Cobras set a database record (24/25 season, T20) with a value of 198. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Cobras.
